data.long_meaning: The name Soyab is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shayana' which means 'to sit' and 'soya' which is the Hindi term for soybean. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and protection, representing the calming and nurturing qualities of the soybean plant. It is a unique and meaningful name for a baby boy. The name Soyab carries the meaning “Cool, Soybean” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Soyab usually hope their child will grow to embody cool, soybean and live with faith, good character and purpose.
